consequence.statement: Existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten; a storage version migration must be run and status.storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ImageRepository objects (storage version migration) and update status.storedVersions.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD changes from v1beta2 to v1, so existing objects stay stored as v1beta2 until a storage version migration is run.
